lines: She spreads Bhairava honor, south petal throned, with distinction-blooms —
sanskrit_cite: vidadhāti bhairavārcāṃ dakṣiṇadalagā viṣeśakusumairyā | nityaṃ manaḥsvarūpāṃ kaumārīṃ tāmahaṃ vande
notes: follows edition viśeśa- (distinction); print variant vikalpa- recorded in L0/argmap, not adopted

lines: Southwest enthroned she Bhairava honors with sound-blooms —
hearing-formed, ever her, Vaiṣṇavī power, bow.
sanskrit_cite: nairṛtadalagā bhairavamarcayate śabdakusumairyā | praṇamāmi śrutirūpāṃ nityaṃ tāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktim
notes: follows edition śabda- (sound); print variant śabdarūpā recorded in L0/argmap, not adopted

lines: Westward firm on her petal, with heart-gladding touch-blooms
she gladdens Bhairava — skin-formed, Vārāhī, honor.
sanskrit_cite: paścimadigdalasaṃsthā hṛdayaharaiḥ sparśakusumairyā | toṣayati bhairavaṃ tāṃ tvagrūpadharāṃ namāmi vārāhīm

lines: With choicest form-parts, wind-quarter-seated in body, who
honors Bhairava — her Indrāṇī, sight-bodied, praise.
sanskrit_cite: varatararūpaviśeṣairmārutadigdalaniṣaṇṇadehā yā | pūjayati bhairavaṃ tāmindrāṇīṃ dṛktanuṃ vande

lines: On wealth-lord's sprout abiding, who with varied six-taste feasts
honors Bhairava ever — tongue-called, Cāmuṇḍā, honor.
sanskrit_cite: dhanapatikisalayanilayā yā nityaṃ vividhaṣaḍrasāhāraiḥ | pūjayati bhairavaṃ tāṃ jihvābhikhyāṃ namāmi cāmuṇḍām

lines: On Īśa's petal throned she Bhairava honors with varied scents —
nose-called Mahālakṣmī, her, ever I bow.
sanskrit_cite: īśadalasthā bhairavamarcayate parimalairvicitrairyā | praṇamāmi sarvadā tāṃ ghrāṇābhikhyāṃ mahālakṣmīm

lines: In six views adorable, thirty-six-truth-filled, self-named ever —
sanskrit_cite: ṣaḍdarśaneṣu pūjyaṃ ṣaḍtriṃśattattvasaṃvalitam | ātmābhikhyaṃ satataṃ kṣetrapatiṃ siddhidaṃ vande

lines: Quivering pith of experience, in all ends, ever at hand —
thus ever risen, my body's god-ring I hymn.
sanskrit_cite: saṃsphuradanubhavasāraṃ sarvāntaḥ satatasannihitam | naumi sadoditamitthaṃ nijadehagadevatācakram
